sentences.text:
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 44455 of 2024
Applicant :- Ram Pyaree Mishra And 2 Others
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Sanjay Kumar Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Prashant Kumar,J.

1. Heard Sri Sanjay Kumar Singh, learned counsel for the applicants and learned A.G.A. for the State.
2.

The present 482 Cr.P.C. application has been filed to quash the summoning order dated 25.07.2019 as well as entire proceedings in Complaint Case No.420 of 2019 (Sanjay Kumar Mishra vs. Ram Pyaree Mishra & others) under Sections 323, 504, 506, 379, 452 I.P.C., against applicant nos.1 & 3 and under Sections 323, 504, 506, 379, 452, 354A IPC, P.S. Mirzamurad, District Varanasi, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Court No.8, Varanasi.

sentences.text: 3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that opposite party no.2 initially lodged complaint against the applicants through application under section 156(3) Cr.P.C. wherein the magistrate vide order dated 04.08.2018 rejected the application filed under section 156(3) Cr.P.C. of opposite party no.2.
Against that order opposite party no.2 preferred revision on 04.08.2018 as Criminal Revision No.194 of 2018.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that during pendency of the revision,
opposite party no.2 again lodged complaint for the same factual dispute and trial court/learned Ram Pyaree Mishra And 2 Others vs State Of U.P. And Another on 8 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/133005303/

sentences.text: magistrate without considering the merit of the case, summoned the accused.

He further submitted that coordinate bench of this Court vide order dated 19.07.2023 passed in Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No.25718 of 2023 has granted interim relief to the co-accused, hence, similar indulgence may also be accorded to the applicants.
4. Matter requires consideration.
5. Notice on behalf of opposite party no.1 has been accepted by learned A.G.A.
6.
Issue notice to opposite party no.2 returnable at an early date.
Steps be taken within a week.
7. Opposite parties may file their counter affidavits within one month.
Rejoinder affidavit may be filed within two weeks thereafter.

8. Connect and list this matter along with Application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. No.25718 of 2023.
9.
Till the next date of listing, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
